packageRules.description: Auto-merge Cargo patch updates after required CI checks pass.
GitHub Actions are pinned to commit SHAs; auto-merge digest updates, which stay on the same major/minor tag (the trailing comment shows the tag).
Container images (Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml) are pinned by digest; auto-merge digest updates, which stay on the same tag.
Our own images are rebuilt on every push to main, so a new digest appears faster than the stability window; skip minimumReleaseAge for them (they are already validated by CI).
Require human review for potentially breaking dependency updates.
